Title: to hunt or not to hunt...

Messages.Author: Demos
Messages.Body:

Messages.Author: LSJ (VtES Rep)
Messages.Body:
Demos wrote:
>
> Alright, LSJ. We have a little disagreement in a game. One of my Vampires
> has Zero blood and has to hunt. I am not disputing that fact. What I am
> disputing is the fact that, that action, hunting, has to be declared FIRST.

When one (or more) of your ready vampires is empty and not prevented
from hunting, your action must be a hunt taken by that (or one of those)
vampire(s). You cannot take any other action as long as you have such
vampires.

--
L. Scott Johnson (vte...@regency.wizards.com)
Official VtES Net.Rep for Wizards of the Coast.
(*) - Subject to review by Rules Team

Messages.Author: LSJ (VtES Rep)
Messages.Body:



That's the question I answered.

"You cannot take any other action as long as you have [any
empty ready vampires that are not prevented from hunting]"

The hypothetical action(s) to be taken by these two other (non-empty)
vampires fall into the "other actions" category.

These "other actions" cannot be taken while you have empty hunt-able

: Eugene Martin wrote:

So, if a vampire with no blood attempts to hunt, but is blocked, does this mean the
other vampires (with blood) still cannot take actions?

Messages.Author: LSJ (VtES Rep)
Messages.Body:


No. After being blocked, the empty vampire will no longer be untapped.
(Part of the official rule, which I've already posted in this thread
at least twice).

Plus, he will be prohibited from hunting by the DCI "No Repeat Actions"
rule. ("Not prohibited from hunting" is another part of the official
hunting rule that I've posted).


